infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: We need access to your contacts to help you find and connect with friends on 34th Street.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We need access to your photos so you can upload a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: We may save edited photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: We need camera access for video calls and profile pictures.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We need microphone access for voice and video calls.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 34th Street uses your location to show your city, calculate nearby members and events, and let you refresh your location when you choose.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to sign in to your 34th Street account quickly and securely.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: 34th Street may access your calendar to help you schedule and manage events.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: 34th Street needs full calendar access to help you schedule and manage events.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow 34thstreet to access your photos so you can upload a profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow 34thstreet to access your camera to take a new profile picture.
Allow 34thstreet to access your camera for video calls.
